title: EATF AEP v1 acceptance.json (detached epistemic acceptance)
description: Validates the optional detached acceptance.json entry inside an AEP v1 evidence package (docs/specs/aep-profile-v1.md, section 4.3). It carries the epistemic accepting authority's acceptance record; acceptance.sig is the Base64 PKCS#1 v1.5 RSA signature (inner digest SHA-256) over the JCS-canonical bytes of this record, verifiable against public_key. The record is bound to the package by metadata.accepting_authority.acceptance_digest (sha256:<hex> of the packaged bytes). The accepting authority is a named principal with a verifiable key binding under the same self-attestation trust model as public_key.pem; nothing in this schema or profile establishes it as a legally constituted authority. Binding verification and authorization appraisal are separate verifier decisions.

principal.description: Named principal identifier of the accepting authority. MUST equal metadata.accepting_authority.principal.

policy_id.description: Policy identifier this acceptance is made against. MUST equal metadata.accepting_authority.policy_id (and metadata.policy_id).

policy_version.description: Policy version this acceptance is made against. MUST equal metadata.accepting_authority.policy_version.

accepted_at.description: When the acceptance was made (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC). Informational; the accepting_authority.validity window governs temporal containment.

public_key.description: PEM-encoded RSA public key of the accepting authority (BEGIN/END PUBLIC KEY headers). acceptance.sig verifies against this key. Role verification against a caller-supplied authorityTrustList, when performed, is reported separately from this key binding.
